app.name: Nom Nom Gacha
app.tagline: Spin to find out what's for dinner!

machine.emptyBody: There are no foods for this meal yet. A grown-up can add some in the settings.

collection.title: Food Collection
collection.empty: Spin the machine and tap a result to start your collection.

pin.title: Grown-ups only
pin.mismatch: The PINs didn't match, start over
pin.resetHint: You can reset the PIN by choosing a new one. Foods and history are kept.

settings.title: Settings
settings.name: Name
settings.starFoodHint: Star foods only appear as rare golden drops, never on normal spins.
settings.deleteConfirm: Delete {{name}}? Its history stays in the log.
settings.slotModeSingleHint: Each of the three reels picks a dish from the same list.
settings.slotModeComboHint: The reels pick a base, a protein and an extra that make up the meal.
settings.starDropsHint: Now and then the machine may suggest a challenge food with a golden celebration. It can always be re-spun.
settings.antiRepeatHint: Foods eaten recently show up a little less often. They can still appear!
settings.clearHistoryConfirm: Delete the whole meal history? The collection book is built from it.
settings.exportHint: Saves foods, settings and history as a file for this family only. The PIN is never included.
settings.importErrorNotJson: That file could not be read.
settings.importErrorNotNomnom: That is not a Nom Nom Gacha backup file.
settings.noFoodsForMeal: Heads up: no enabled foods for {{meal}}.
settings.threeOfAKindHint: Three matching foods on the payline is always a jackpot.
settings.jackpotCombosHint: A spin matching one of these food trios (in any order) also counts as a jackpot.
settings.exportSetupHint: Saves just the food list and machine settings — no meal history, no PIN. Perfect for sending to another device or family.
settings.importPreviewBackup: This backup contains {{foods}} foods and {{log}} logged meals. Replace everything on this device?
settings.importPreviewSetup: This setup contains {{foods}} foods and {{combos}} jackpot combinations. Replace the foods and machine settings on this device? Meal history, app settings and the PIN are kept.

onboarding.welcomeBody: Nom Nom Gacha is a friendly slot machine that helps decide what to eat. Every food on the reels is one you have chosen together — every spin is a win.
onboarding.privacy: Everything stays on this device. No accounts, no internet needed.
onboarding.pinBody: The PIN protects the food list and settings.
onboarding.foodsBody: We added some common foods to start with. Remove anything that doesn't fit — you can add your own later.

recovery.title: Fresh start
recovery.body: Stored data could not be read, so the app started fresh. A copy of the old data was kept.
